name: What is the process for starting a restoration remodeling project with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a restoration remodeling project with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation and thorough inspection of your property to assess the damage or scope of work. We then develop a detailed project plan, including proposed solutions, material selections, and a transparent cost estimate. Once approved, we handle all necessary permits and scheduling. Our team then executes the restoration or remodel with consistent communication, ensuring quality and adherence to the plan. The project concludes with a final walk-through and client approval.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, inspection, detailed planning, cost estimation, permitting, execution with communication, and a final walk-through.
